label: Engraved Lines
blurb: Rebuilds the picture the way a banknote or an old share certificate is engraved: a field of fine ruled lines where the line swells in the shadows and thins to nothing in the highlights, so the tone is carried entirely by how fat the ink is. The lines are not straight, they ride over the shape of the subject, bending round what is in front of them the way a hand engraver follows a face, and a second finer set can be laid across the first for the dense black areas. Choose the ink and paper colours and how close together the rules run.
